title: The diagonal concavity conjecture for sums of elementary symmetric polynomials
statement:
Let $n,p\in\mathbb{N}^*$, let $\Gamma_n$ be the positive cone, let $\Delta=\{(X,\ldots,X):X>0\}$ be its positive diagonal, and let

$$
f_{\overrightarrow{a}}=a_0+a_1\sigma_1+\cdots+a_p\sigma_p,
$$

where $\overrightarrow{a}=(a_0,\ldots,a_p)\in(\mathbb{R}_+)^{p+1}$. Define the diagonal restriction

$$
\bar f_{\overrightarrow{a}}(X)=\sum_{k=0}^p a_k\binom{n}{k}X^k.
$$

**Diagonal concavity conjecture.** The function $f_{\overrightarrow{a}}$ is $\frac1p$-concave on $\Gamma_n$ if and only if it is $\frac1p$-concave on $\Delta$, if and only if $\bar f_{\overrightarrow{a}}$ is $\frac1p$-concave on $\mathbb{R}_+^*$. Equivalently, $\mathcal{K}_n^p=\mathcal{X}_n^p$. The conjecture is explicitly stated as unproved in the paper, although equivalence is established in some cases.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1712.10327

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2017).
source_name: Xavier Lachaume, “On the concavity of a sum of elementary symmetric polynomials”, arXiv:1712.10327 (2017).
